messages:
priya: Quick update — two bits of personal news: I got promoted to Director of Product 🎉 and Jamie and I are expecting a baby in Sept! Wanted to share the good news here :)

lina: OMG congrats!!! :tada: that's amazing on both counts :smile:

omar: huge congrats Priya!! Director!! and baby!!! when's the due date?

priya: thanks!! due Sept 16. Promotion starts next Monday. Feeling equal parts terrified and excited 😂

kevin: cake? virtual shower? we should 100% do something. if you want a gift we can start a collection. @people-ops do we have a policy for gifts/bonus?

sophie: +1 to a little virtual shower. I can make time for a weds lunch video if that works. also will find local bakery recs near SF office.

marta: congrats!! would love to sign up for a meal train after the baby — happy to coordinate. any registry link yet?

priya: not yet, will send registry link this week. A virtual shower next Wednesday 12pm PT would be lovely if folks can make it.

hr-bot: CONGRATULATIONS Priya! HR has recorded promotion for payroll and badge access. Please submit manager confirmation form at: https://redwood.example/hr/promotions

omar: sent an event invite for Wed 12pm PT. RSVP please so I can order a cake if in-office people want one 🎂

kevin: RSVP'd. cake flavor poll: chocolate, lemon, carrot. vote with emoji: :chocolate_bar: chocolate, :lemon: lemon, :carrot: carrot

sophie: :chocolate_bar:

lina: :carrot:

marta: :chocolate_bar:

priya: you all are the best. thank you so much <3
